settings.html: Urgent? Call us

settings.title: For Urgent HVAC Problems, Call Us Directly

settings.editor: If your furnace stops working during cold weather, your AC fails during extreme heat, or your home becomes uncomfortable quickly, calling is the best next step.
Lenz Heating & Cooling provides 24/7 emergency heating and cooling service across Des Moines and surrounding Central Iowa communities.
Call right away if you are dealing with:

settings.html:
• No heat during freezing weather
  • No cooling during extreme heat
  • Burning or electrical smells
  • Water around HVAC equipment
  • Repeated breaker trips
  • Unsafe indoor temperatures
  • A system that will not turn on at all

What to expect

settings.title: What Happens After You Reach Out

settings.editor: We know that contacting an HVAC company can feel stressful when your home is uncomfortable. Our process is simple and built around clear communication.

settings.html: 1

settings.editor: Our team looks at your message, service location, system details, and the issue you are experiencing.

settings.html: 2

settings.editor: We may contact you to ask follow-up questions, confirm your address, or help determine whether you need repair, maintenance, emergency service, or an estimate.

settings.html: 3

settings.title: We Help Schedule the Right Service

settings.editor: Once we understand what is happening, we help you schedule the right type of appointment based on your needs and availability.

settings.html: 4

settings.editor: Before work begins, our technicians explain what they find and review your options so you can make a confident decision.
